description: One routing rule of an approved escalation matrix. The condition is data, evaluated by consilium.escalation.routing.

fields.description: Stable identifier. Stored on the matter as the trace of which rule fired, and joins the route and notification rows below.
fields.label: Rule Code

fields.description: Lowest number wins. Rules are evaluated in priority order and the first match fires.
fields.label: Priority

fields.description: Object over escalation_type, tier_1_risk_type, tier_2_risk_type, organizational_level, material_entity_impact and risk_appetite_breach. An absent key means 'any'. A list value means 'one of'.
fields.label: Condition

fields.description: Assignment by role: the matter waits in this role's queue until a holder of the role takes ownership of the response.
fields.label: Route To Role

fields.description: Assignment by group: the matter waits in this group's queue until a member takes ownership of the response. May be set with or instead of the role.
fields.label: Route To Group

fields.description: The time threshold this rule imposes. Core's SLA clock measures it; breach raises the matter.
fields.label: SLA Definition

name: Escalation Matrix Rule
